# ABECT — Ukrainian Web Studio

> ABECT is a Ukrainian web development studio. We build landing pages, corporate websites, online stores and web apps — on the Weblium website builder (fast and affordable) or with custom code on Next.js (unique design, no platform limits) — for businesses in Ukraine and Europe. The site is available in Ukrainian (default) and English.

## Contact

- [Website](https://agency.abect.com)
- [Email: agency@abect.com](mailto:agency@abect.com)
- [Telegram](https://t.me/abect_agency)
- [Phone: +380 98 027 5819](tel:+380980275819)

## Services

- Landing page — from $120: one-page website for a product, service or ad campaign
- Multi-page / corporate website — from $300: company website with service pages and navigation
- Online store — from $450: catalog, cart, payments, delivery integrations
- Website on Weblium — budget option on a website builder; texts and photos can be edited without a developer
- Web apps — custom functionality, user accounts, integrations (custom code only)
- Design: website and logo design
- Promotion: ad campaigns for the launched website

Prices are "from" values shown on the homepage; the exact cost of a specific project is shown by the online calculator and fixed in an estimate after a short brief. Domain and hosting are paid separately.

## Website cost calculator

- [Website cost calculator (UA)](https://agency.abect.com/calculator)
- [Website cost calculator (EN)](https://agency.abect.com/en/calculator)

How the price is calculated: base price (project type × platform: Weblium or custom code; includes one page) + a fixed amount for each additional page + fixed prices of selected extra services (SEO optimization, copywriting, multilingual support, CRM / payment integrations, animations, technical support), multiplied by an urgency coefficient (urgent — higher, flexible timeline — discount), but not less than the minimum order. The result is the lower limit of the budget; after the request the team prepares an exact estimate with a timeline.

## How we work

Brief → structure and design → development (Weblium or Next.js + Payload CMS) → mobile adaptation, technical SEO, SSL and Google registration → launch on the client's domain and handover of access → support on request. Lead forms on our websites send notifications to Telegram.

## Geography

Ukraine and Europe; communication in Ukrainian and English.
